limitations.symptom: BinDiff result database grows beyond provider limits on very large inputs
limitations.workaround: Restrict to compatible components or rely on Ghidriff results
limitations.symptom_regex: (?i)(database or disk is full|too many functions)

limitations.symptom: BinExport may fail on functions with overlapping or non-contiguous bodies
limitations.workaround: Result marked SKIPPED_KNOWN_LIMITATION; Ghidriff evidence kept

limitations.symptom: Memory consumption grows quadratically with function count
limitations.workaround: Memory gate skips or reduces the perimeter (ACET-QBD-001)

limitations.symptom: Packed or virtualized code yields poor function boundary recovery
limitations.workaround: Extraction quality lowers reliability; never interpreted as a software change (ACET-SCI-003)
